mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic; diclofenac reduces renal perfusion via COX inhibition while gentamicin accumulates in proximal tubular cells, synergistically increasing acute kidney injury risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) closely, ensure adequate hydration, use lowest effective diclofenac dose, and consider alternative antibiotics.
